synthesis: Scout (/scout) is a full-bleed Google Maps Vue 3 SPA where floating chrome blankets the map on phones. The driver app's top-left controls (280px), top-right Map Layers (280px), Live Hits / Hit-markers key (280px), and bottom stat bar (min-width 380px) overlap and overflow below ~430px. Make these driver-app surfaces map-first on small screens: auto-collapse to compact chips below the Tailwind lg breakpoint (1024px) so the map is unobstructed on first paint, expand on tap, persist the user's explicit choice, desktop unchanged. Admin Org Map / Bird's Eye (mapStore.adminMode) is out of scope and must not regress.
